title: Article 125 Article 125  If, at or after the time when it becomes possible to ratify an act, any of the following facts occur with respect to a voidable act, it is deemed that the act has been ratified; provided, however, that this does not apply if an objection is reserved:

variables.description: An act that is capable of being ratified or rescinded.
The point in time at which it becomes possible to ratify an act.
variables.supporting_span: time when it becomes possible to ratify an act

variables.description: The legal status of an act being ratified.

predicates.description: The point in time at which it becomes possible to ratify an act.
predicates.supporting_span: at or after the time when it becomes possible to ratify an act

predicates.description: A voidable act that may be ratified or rescinded.
Full or partial performance of a voidable act.
A request for the performance of a voidable act.
Provision of a security for a voidable act.
Assignment of part or all of a right acquired by the voidable act.
predicates.supporting_span: assignment of a part of or the whole of a right acquired by the voidable act

predicates.description: Compulsory execution of a voidable act.
The act is deemed to have been ratified.
predicates.supporting_span: it is deemed that the act has been ratified

predicates.description: Whether an objection was reserved regarding a voidable act.

conditions: (full_or_partial_performance_occurred(VoidableAct) OR request_for_performance_occurred(VoidableAct) OR novation_occurred(VoidableAct) OR security_provided_for_act(VoidableAct) OR right_assigned_by_voidable_act(VoidableAct) OR compulsory_execution_occurred(VoidableAct))
rules.supporting_span: If, at or after the time when it becomes possible to ratify an act, any of the following facts occur with respect to a voidable act, it is deemed that the act has been ratified; provided, however, that this does not apply if an objection is reserved:
rules.explanation: A voidable act is deemed ratified if certain conditions (performance, request, novation, security, assignment, or compulsory execution) occur after the ratification time is reached and no objection is reserved.

conditions: (full_or_partial_performance_occurred(VoidableAct) OR request_for_performance_occurred(VoidableAct) OR novation_occurred(VoidableAct) OR security_provided_for_act(VoidableAct) OR right_assigned_by_voidable_act(VoidableAct) OR compulsory_execution_occurred(VoidableAct))
rules.supporting_span: provided, however, that this does not apply if an objection is reserved:
rules.explanation: If an objection is reserved, the act is not deemed ratified even if other conditions are met.
